title: Hardship Desk Note — Hardship Relief Installments on a Payment Arrangements Restructure
content:
Hardship relief is a number of installments added to the restructured count of a plan under Payment Arrangements, set by the hardship hold that suspended the plan.

## Rule

The hold is the one on the plan's account whose decision date is the plan's suspended date, as recorded under Hardship and Protective Holds: its ended date, its tier's documentation requirement, and the financial assistance decisions the client recorded on the hold's event history (the most recent decision counts).

- A hold that ended no more than 60 days before the handling date and on which the client recorded an approved-full or approved-partial financial assistance decision adds 2 installments.
- A hold of a tier that needs documentation that ended no more than 60 days before the handling date without such a decision adds 1 installment.
- Any other case adds none.

The 60 days are calendar days from the hold's ended date to the handling date; a hold that ended exactly 60 days earlier is within them. A hold with no ended date is "any other case".

## Grid

| Hold ended | Most recent assistance decision approved full or partial | Tier needs documentation | Hardship relief |
|---|---|---|---|
| 60 days or fewer before the handling date | Yes | Either | 2 installments |
| 60 days or fewer before the handling date | No | Yes | 1 installment |
| 60 days or fewer before the handling date | No | No | None |
| More than 60 days before, or not ended | Either | Either | None |

## Hypothetical holds (handling date 30 June)

- Ended 1 May (60 days before), client decision approved-full: 2 installments.
- Ended 1 May, documented tier, no approved decision on the hold: 1 installment.
- Ended 30 April (61 days before), client decision approved-partial: none.
